claim.headline: Antibody against USAG-1 regrows teeth in mice
claim.summary: Researchers at Kyoto University and the University of Fukui reported that one dose of an antibody blocking the protein USAG-1 grew a whole new tooth in mice with congenital tooth agenesis, with similar results in ferrets. The paper appeared in Science Advances in February 2021.
